description: Defines the ProxyConfigService class and related components for managing and observing proxy configuration changes within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ProxyConfigService
classes.description: Service for managing proxy configuration and notifying observers of changes.

classes.name: ProxyConfigService::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified when proxy configuration changes.

methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.description: Retrieves the most recent proxy configuration status.

methods.description: Periodically called to signal activity for polling-based implementations.

methods.name: UsesPolling
